title: Warning Against Adultery

questions.question: The lips of a forbidden woman drip what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:3 (ESV): "For the lips of a forbidden woman drip honey,"

questions.question: But in the end she is bitter as what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:4 (ESV): "but in the end she is bitter as wormwood,"

questions.question: Her feet go down to death; her steps follow the path to where?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:5 (ESV): "her steps follow the path to Sheol;"

questions.question: Keep your way far from her, and do not go near the door of her what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:8 (ESV): "and do not go near the door of her house,"

questions.question: Drink water from your own what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:15 (ESV): "Drink water from your own cistern,"

questions.question: Lest you give your honor to others and your years to the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:9 (ESV): "and your years to the merciless,"

questions.question: Lest strangers take their fill of your strength, and your labors go to the house of a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:10 (ESV): "and your labors go to the house of a foreigner,"

questions.question: And at the end of your life you groan, when your flesh and body are what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:11 (ESV): "when your flesh and body are consumed,"

questions.question: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice in the wife of your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:18 (ESV): "and rejoice in the wife of your youth,"

questions.question: For a man's ways are before the eyes of whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:21 (ESV): "For a man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord,"

questions.question: Her speech is smoother than what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:3 (ESV): "and her speech is smoother than oil,"

questions.question: Why should you be intoxicated with another woman's breasts, my son? Why embrace the bosom of an what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:20 (ESV): "Why embrace the bosom of an adulteress?"

questions.question: The iniquities of the wicked ensnare him, and he is held fast in the cords of his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:22 (ESV): "and he is held fast in the cords of his sin."

questions.question: He dies for lack of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:23 (ESV): "He dies for lack of discipline,"

questions.question: She does not ponder the path of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 5:6 (ESV): "She does not ponder the path of life;"

key_verse_text: For a man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord, and he ponders all his paths.
